issues.where: place 1, the dark cloud gradient and the star cluster on the right
issues.what: The encoded gradient breaks into flat, blocky patches, and several faint but distinct stars are gone.
issues.fix: Give the night shot more of the available bit budget and protect the star highlights. Test subtle gradient dithering against the same 5 Mbit/s encode.

issues.where: places 1 and 2, the foreground foliage and the dense middle-distance sunflower rows
issues.what: Fine stems and leaf edges merge into smeared dark patches, while small sunflower heads lose their distinct petal outlines.
issues.fix: Allocate more bits to the wide field shot and suppress expendable background grain before encoding so the stem and petal edges retain definition.

issues.where: places 1 and 2, around the top leaves and across the bright cloud band
issues.what: Many of the thinner rain streaks break into soft flecks or disappear, and leaf veins smear into broader green patches.
issues.fix: Prioritize the rain shot in the bitrate allocation. If needed, reduce background grain and make fewer rain streaks slightly more distinct before re-encoding.

issues.where: place 3, the blue-to-gray transition above the violet cloud
issues.what: The encoded sky shows visible tonal steps where the source gradient is smooth.
issues.fix: Keep the sky gradient in higher precision through compositing and test low-amplitude dithering and lower quantization for the sky at the target bitrate.
